prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his graduate studies in zoology around 1951–52, the schools in his hometown of Hoxie, Arkansas, were still racially segregated. Hoxie did not desegregate its public schools until July 1955, after *Brown v. Board of Education* (1954); it then became one of the first Arkansas districts to integrate, amid significant white opposition and boycotts.
